Dear Eiger Metallwerk GmbH,

Thank you for your response and for offering the improved lead time of 14 days.

We have reviewed your offer of 0.83 USD per unit with a 14-day lead time for 10,000 units of M8 stainless hex bolts. To proceed with this order, we would need a unit price of 0.76 USD and a lead time of 12 days.

Would you be able to accommodate this request? We value your partnership and look forward to your reply.

Best regards,
ProcureAI Demo Buyer
